title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/configs/[entity]
responsibility: Shows one config at a branch tip or a selected commit: its contract, size, performance and what proves it.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The config with its verdict, what it provides and what uses it. Relationships and tests by tab.

errors.name: not-in-history
errors.description: A branch or commit the history does not hold, or a commit the branch does not contain, is said. No other revision is shown.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so. The registry of another revision is not shown.

errors.name: not-at-revision
errors.description: A config the shown revision does not hold is said, with the way back to the collection.

errors.name: other-category
errors.description: A unit that is not a config at this revision is led to the address of its own category.

errors.name: not-admitted
errors.description: A request the owner policy does not admit is refused before any history is read.
